data.description: Exploring Dubai Academic City: A Hub of Residential and Lifestyle Excellence

data.answer:
The DIAC community provides students a well-balanced lifestyle in one of the world's most vibrant cities. With numerous amenities nearby and budget-friendly apartments, the community offers a peaceful retreat for academic learners.

The infrastructure of this development spans a total area of 129 million sq. ft., 20 million of which is dedicated solely to colleges and universities. An additional 8 million sq. ft. has been designated as a free zone sector known as Dubai International Academic City (DIAC), located in the northeastern part of the greater Dubai Academic City.

As a free zone area under the Dubai Creative Clusters Authority (DCCA), DIAC serves over 27,000 students from approximately 150 different nationalities. It is the world’s largest educational free trade zone dedicated to foreign higher education. This sector operates with 100% foreign ownership of universities and colleges.

Academic City is home to numerous residential spaces designed for students. In addition to academic campuses, the area includes a dedicated 3 million sq. ft. for research and development centers, such as the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA). Moreover, Academic City comprises commercial projects alongside numerous government-based educational institutes.

The apartments in Academic City are typically built like compounds, with large open-roofed entrance halls and encircling corridors lined with spacious units. Resembling a library, these units feature large living spaces and high ceilings, creating a light and airy atmosphere. Granite flooring and kitchens with marble tops add stability to the overall theme. Many apartments also have balconies where students can set up study spots overlooking the serene landscaped parks surrounding these compounds.

Facilities such as car parking and 24-hour security are provided for each student. The residential blocks offer easy access to amenities, including mini-parks, shops, restaurants, and schools. Public transport and commercial buildings are also easily accessible from these units, making life in Academic City convenient and enjoyable for students.

Rental Properties in Dubai Academic City

Are they looking for properties for rent in Dubai? Several blocks of hostels are near Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani), offering a range of rental options from studios to 1-bed and 2-bed Academic City apartments for rent. These rental properties are quite affordable, making it manageable for students to cover their living expenses. 
Rental prices for studios in Academic City Dubai apartments start from AED 35k per year, with a minimum living area of 380 sq. ft. 1-bedroom apartments begin at AED 65k annually, typically covering an area of 826 sq. ft. For those seeking 2-bedroom apartments, the annual rent is at least AED 80k.
The Myriad, a student housing community completed in 2020, is a notable development in Academic City. Spanning 60,000 sq. m., this residential complex comprises approximately 1,820 rooms and includes green courtyards, swimming pools, gyms, coffee shops, and other communal facilities. Another popular option for students is the Al Shiba Complex, which offers proximity to educational institutes.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Academic City?

data.answer:
Dubai Academic City offers a unique lifestyle primarily centered around education and student life. The area is home to numerous international universities and colleges, attracting a diverse student community from around the globe. 

The area is well-equipped with amenities such as libraries, study spaces, recreational facilities, sports complexes, gyms, and dining options. The presence of green spaces and landscaped areas adds to the serenity and relaxation opportunities.

Public Transportation in Dubai Academic City

Public transportation in Academic City is efficient and well-connected, making commuting easy for students and residents. Several bus routes connect residents and visitors to the nearest metro station to Dubai Academic City, the Centrepoint Metra Station. Taxis and ride-sharing services are also readily available, offering convenient travel options for those who prefer door-to-door transport.

Supermarkets in Academic City

Dubai Academic City offers several supermarkets and grocery stores to cater to the daily needs of its residents and students. Notable supermarkets include Spinneys and Carrefour, which provide a wide range of products, from fresh produce to household essentials. 

Shopping Malls Near Academic City Area

While Dubai Academic City itself is primarily an educational hub with limited shopping options, several prominent shopping malls are located nearby. Dubai Silicon Oasis, just a 10-minute drive away, features the Cedre Shopping Centre, which offers a variety of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment facilities. 

A bit further, the Mirdif City Centre, located about 20 minutes away, provides an extensive shopping experience with numerous retail outlets, a hypermarket, a cinema, and a wide range of dining options.

Schools in Academic City Dubai

Dubai Academic City hosts several esteemed international schools that offer a range of curricula to cater to the diverse expatriate population. These schools provide comprehensive education programs from primary to secondary levels, ensuring that students receive a well-rounded education. 
Schools such as GEMS Wellington Academy and The Indian International School are known for their academic excellence, extracurricular activities, and state-of-the-art facilities. The presence of these schools within Academic City ensures that families residing in the area have access to high-quality education for their children.

Universities in Dubai Academic City

Dubai Academic City is renowned for its concentration of top-tier universities offering a diverse array of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs. Institutions like Heriot-Watt University, Amity University, and the University of Wollongong in Dubai attract students from around the world. 
These universities are known for their high academic standards, cutting-edge research facilities, and strong industry connections, which provide students with valuable learning experiences and career opportunities. The international environment fosters a multicultural academic community, enhancing the overall educational experience.

Academic City Dubai Colleges

In addition to universities, Dubai Academic City is home to several prestigious colleges that offer specialized programs and vocational training. Colleges such as Dubai Men’s College and Dubai Women’s College provide a wide range of diploma and degree courses in fields like business, engineering, health sciences, and media. 

These institutions focus on practical, career-oriented education, preparing students for the professional world with hands-on training and industry internships. The presence of these colleges ensures that students have access to diverse educational pathways to suit their career aspirations.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and Near Dubai Academic City

Dubai Academic City is surrounded by a variety of religious facilities catering to different faiths, reflecting the city's multicultural and inclusive environment. For Muslim residents, several mosques are located within a short drive, such as the Academic City Mosque, which offers regular prayer services and community activities. 

Christian residents can find churches like the St. Mary’s Catholic Church in Oud Metha, approximately 25 minutes away by car. Hindu residents can visit the temples in Bur Dubai, such as the Shiva and Krishna temples, which are around 30 minutes away. These facilities ensure that residents of all faiths have access to their places of worship within a reasonable distance.

Clinics and Hospitals Near Dubai Academic City Area

Dubai Academic City is well-served by a range of medical facilities, ensuring residents have access to quality healthcare. Nearby clinics such as the Mediclinic Silicon Oasis and Aster Clinic provide comprehensive outpatient services, including general practice, specialist consultations, and diagnostic services, within a 10 to 15-minute drive. 

Dubai Academic City Location & Nearby Areas

Dubai Academic City is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, providing convenient access to several key areas. It is situated approximately 20 minutes from the bustling Dubai Silicon Oasis, a vibrant residential and commercial area. Mirdif, known for its family-friendly environment and shopping centers, is about 20 minutes away. 

The central business district of Downtown Dubai, with its iconic landmarks and commercial hubs, is around 30 minutes by car. For those seeking waterfront living and nightlife, Dubai Marina is a 40-minute drive. These proximities make Dubai Academic City an accessible and well-connected area for both students and residents.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Dubai Academic City

data.answer:
Dubai Academic City offers a range of activities catering to students and residents alike. The area features various recreational facilities, including sports complexes where you can engage in activities like basketball, football, and tennis. There are several parks and green spaces ideal for jogging, picnics, and outdoor workouts. 

The numerous cafes and study lounges provide perfect spots for socializing or catching up on studies. Cultural and academic events, such as seminars, workshops, and student festivals, frequently take place, fostering a vibrant community life. 

Restaurants in Academic City

Dubai Academic City boasts a variety of dining options that cater to diverse tastes and preferences. On-campus and nearby restaurants offer a mix of international and local cuisines. Popular spots include student-friendly cafes, fast-food chains, and casual dining establishments. Whether you're in the mood for a quick bite or a sit-down meal, you can find options like Subway, Pizza Hut, and local favorites that serve traditional Middle Eastern dishes. The availability of diverse dining options ensures that students and residents have access to delicious meals throughout the day.

For those looking to explore dining options outside of Dubai Academic City, the nearby areas offer a plethora of choices. Dubai Silicon Oasis, just a 10-minute drive away, has a range of restaurants near Academic City Dubai like Oregano, Shakespeare and Co., and Chongqing Liuyishou Hotpot.

Beaches Near Dubai Academic City

While Dubai Academic City is inland, residents and students can easily access some of Dubai’s beautiful beaches. Jumeirah Beach, one of the most popular beaches in Dubai, is approximately a 30-minute drive away. This beach offers pristine sands, clear waters, and a range of facilities including cafes, restaurants, and water sports.

Hotels Near Academic City Dubai

For visitors or those seeking hotels near Dubai International Academic City, several hotels in the surrounding areas offer comfortable and convenient stays. Premier Inn Dubai Silicon Oasis, just 10 minutes away, provides budget-friendly accommodations with amenities such as a rooftop pool and restaurant. The Radisson Blu Hotel in Dubai Silicon Oasis offers a more upscale experience with luxurious rooms, multiple dining options, and extensive leisure facilities.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Dubai Academic City Dubai

Dubai Academic City is well-positioned to provide access to several notable attractions and landmarks. Just a short drive away, you can visit the iconic Dubai Frame, which offers stunning views of both old and new Dubai from its sky deck, located about 25 minutes away. 

The Dubai Safari Park, around 20 minutes away, provides an opportunity to see a variety of wildlife in a naturalistic setting. For shopping and entertainment, Dubai Festival City Mall, approximately 30 minutes from Academic City, features a wide range of retail outlets, restaurants, and the spectacular IMAGINE water, light, and fire show. 

Outdoor Activities, Salons, and Gyms

Dubai Academic City and its surrounding areas offer a variety of options for outdoor activities, personal care, and fitness. For outdoor enthusiasts, the nearby Mushrif Park, about 15 minutes away, is perfect for picnics, cycling, and horse riding. 

When it comes to personal care, numerous salons in the vicinity provide a range of services, from haircuts and styling to spa treatments. Popular spots like Tips and Toes and Beauty Connection Spa are easily accessible.

For fitness enthusiasts, there are several gyms and fitness centers in and around Dubai Academic City. Options include Fitness First at Dubai Silicon Oasis and Gold’s Gym at Mirdif City Centre, both offering state-of-the-art equipment, group classes, and personal training services.

One minor drawback of living in Dubai Academic City is its relatively limited variety of entertainment and dining options within the immediate vicinity. While the area is excellent for academic pursuits and has basic amenities, residents may need to travel to nearby neighborhoods like Dubai Silicon Oasis or Mirdif for a broader selection of restaurants, shopping, and leisure activities.

Which metro station is near Academic City Dubai?

The metro station is a bit far from Dubai Academic City, but you can easily find a bus to reach Centrepoint Metro Station, which is approximately 20 minutes away.

Where is Academic City located in Dubai?

Dubai Academic City is located in the eastern part of Dubai, near the intersection of Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311) and Dubai-Al Ain Road (E66). It is strategically situated to provide easy access to various parts of the city and is close to other major areas like Dubai Silicon Oasis and Mirdif. 

How many universities are in Academic City Dubai?

Dubai Academic City is home to over 25 universities and higher education institutions.

What courses does Academic City University offer?

Courses offered by universities in Dubai Academic City vary widely, including undergraduate and postgraduate programs in fields such as business, engineering, IT, media, arts, health sciences, and law. Specific offerings depend on the individual university.

Are there any culinary schools in Dubai International Academic City?

Yes, the International Centre for Culinary Arts (ICCA) offers culinary programs in Dubai International Academic City.

Where can I find Aviation Academies In Dubai?

Aviation academies in Dubai include the Emirates Aviation University, located near Dubai International Airport, and the Dubai Aerospace Enterprise Flight Academy, located in Dubai South.

Are there any French schools in DIAC?

There are no French schools specifically in Dubai International Academic City. However, the Lycée Français International Georges Pompidou has multiple campuses in Dubai, including one in Dubai Silicon Oasis, which is nearby.

Which Are Some Business Schools In Academic City?

Some business schools in Dubai International Academic City include the University of Dubai, the Institute of Management Technology (IMT) Dubai, and the University of Wollongong in Dubai.

data.content:
Dubai International Academic City, more often known as Academic City, is a premier educational hub in the heart of Dubai. Established to foster academic growth and innovation, this vibrant area is home to some of the world's leading universities and educational institutions.

The residential options in Dubai Academic City are designed to cater to the diverse needs of its residents. From modern apartments to spacious villas, the area provides a variety of housing choices that meet different preferences and budgets.

The area is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through major road networks, ensuring that all the city's attractions and business districts are within easy reach.

nodes.title: Tilal Binghatti Dunes Villas
nodes.about:
Tilal Binghatti Dunes Villas is an exclusive residential development located in Academic City, Dubai. As part of Binghatti's first-ever villa community, the project offers 4-bedroom villas designed to deliver the perfect balance of luxury and privacy.

With a starting price of AED 4.2M, the development presents an accessible entry into a high-potential investment, supported by strong capital appreciation driven by its strategic location and premium amenities. The villas offer a quieter residential setting focused on greenery, family-friendly outdoor living, and wellness. Residents enjoy direct access to the wider community, including Pearl Beach, the Alwaha swimmable lakes, and the Aira Realm Central Park with its 1.6 km cycling and jogging track.

Tilal Binghatti Dunes Villas by Binghatti Developers feature expansive floor plans, double-height living areas, resort-scale private pools, and superior quality finishes. With a Retail Boulevard, Clubhouse, wellness zones, nursery, clinics, mosque, and over 50 amenities in total, the community delivers a lifestyle of  convenience and long-term value.

nodes.title: Tilal Binghatti Oasis Villas
nodes.about:
The Oasis Villas places buyers at the heart of Tilal Binghatti. Sitting at the center of the masterplan, the cluster connects directly to the beachfront, clubhouse, and central parks, making it the most socially connected pocket of Binghatti's first-ever villa community.

Built around a vibrant, family-oriented atmosphere, the Oasis Villas suit buyers who want to have an active lifestyle. Children's play areas, open green spaces, and walkable leisure destinations are all within reach, while the wider community brings together retail, dining, wellness, and schools under one community.

Each villa offers four bedrooms, double-height living areas, an in-unit elevator, a driver's and maid's room, and a private resort-scale pool. Interiors carry a layered palette of marble, light oak, travertine, and metal detailing, finished to mansion-grade standards.

nodes.title: Greenz
nodes.about:
Greenz by Danube is the developer's first townhouse and villa community, featuring 3- and 4-bedroom townhouses alongside spacious 5-bedroom villas. Located in Al Rowaiyah First within Academic City, Greenz offers resort-style amenities, including a beach lagoon, indoor cinema, business center, podcast room, and more.

Greenz by Danube in Dubai is positioned to attract long-term investors and end users seeking strong growth potential in a prime location. The fully furnished residences feature private elevators and are available with Danube Properties’ flexible 1% payment plan, which the developer is widely known for.
